ghosttyFork.commitMessage:
ghostty: add ghostty_surface_set_selection_range C API

Exports a C function that sets a selection range from buffer (screen)
coordinates.  Used by cmux keyboard copy mode to place the copy-mode
cursor (1-cell selection) and to set visual-mode selections from an
arbitrary anchor point.

changes.description: Update scrollToTop/scrollToBottom to track viewport state
changes.code:
case .scrollToTop:
    _ = performBindingAction("scroll_to_top")
    copyViewportTopScreenRow = 0
    refreshCopyCursorViewportRowAfterScroll(surface: surface)
    placeCopyModeCursor(surface: surface)
case .scrollToBottom:
    _ = performBindingAction("scroll_to_bottom")
    let viewportRows = max(Int(ghostty_surface_size(surface).rows), 1)
    if var cursor = copyCursor {
        cursor.viewportRow = viewportRows - 1
        copyCursor = cursor
        placeCopyModeCursor(surface: surface)
    }

slices.summary: Adds Ctrl-v to enter visual block (rectangle) mode with rectangular selection between anchor and cursor.

userVisibleChange.before: Ctrl-v → does nothing. No rectangle selection available.
userVisibleChange.after: Ctrl-v → enters visual block mode. Rectangle selection from anchor to cursor. Yank copies rectangular block of text.

manual: Build: ./scripts/reload.sh --tag slice4-block
Enter copy mode. Press v → regular visual mode. Press Ctrl-v instead → visual block mode.
Move cursor with j/k/h/l → rectangle selection grows.
Press y → copies block content to clipboard.
Press o in block mode → swaps anchor, preserves block mode.
Press v in block mode → returns to normal mode, clears block flag.
edgeCases: Block extending past viewport → viewport scrolls
Transition from block mode to regular visual mode and back
verification.automated: Existing CI E2E copy-mode tests still pass.

slices.notes: Ghostty's read_selection already handles rectangular selections — no changes needed for the yank handler. Clipboard contains newline-separated lines, each trimmed to block width.

slices.name: Selection Color & Overlay Enhancement
slices.summary: Ensures the copy-mode cursor and selection are always clearly visible regardless of theme, via high-contrast selection color override and optional overlay cursor.

userVisibleChange.before: Cursor/selection may be invisible on low-contrast themes. Selection uses theme's selection colors (could be subtle). No fallback if Ghostty rendering fails.
userVisibleChange.after: Cursor always visible with forced high-contrast colors. Selection uses high-contrast override in copy mode. Optional overlay cursor CALayer as fallback.
